title: Row, Row, Row Your Boat - A Sing-Along Song for Toddlers
description: Row down the gentle stream and wave to the ducks! Sing along with us. #kidssong #nurseryrhyme #toddlersongs #singalong #boatsong
characters: Three adorable Black toddlers: Zuri, a 3-year-old girl with deep warm brown skin, round afro puffs tied with soft yellow fabric scrunchies, wearing a sunny yellow t-shirt, denim dungaree shorts and white sneakers; Kofi, a 4-year-old boy with medium-deep brown skin, short dark natural curly hair, wearing a blue t-shirt, grey jogger shorts and red sneakers; and Nala, a 3-year-old girl with deep brown skin, neat cornrow braids, wearing a yellow pinafore dress over a white t-shirt, white tights and pink sneakers

verses.scene: The three toddlers sit in a little wooden rowboat on a calm sunny stream lined with tall green reeds.

lines: Row and clap along with me
Row your boat, one, two, three
verses.scene: The toddlers pull their oars together in time, clapping once between strokes, laughing on the bright water.
The rowboat drifts up to a pebbly little shore where cartoon ducks paddle alongside, and the toddlers wave.

lines: Row and clap along with me
Row your boat, one, two, three
verses.scene: The toddlers pull their oars together in time, clapping once between strokes, laughing on the bright water.
Warm golden sunshine sparkles on the stream as the little boat glides along under a big blue sky.

pd_source.author: Traditional (American)
pd_source.publication: The Franklin Square Song Collection and earlier American songsters; the words appear in print from 1852, the familiar round from 1881.
pd_source.public_domain: Anonymous traditional text printed from 1852 onward — expired copyright in the US (pre-1929) and worldwide.
pd_source.adaptation: Verse 1 is the traditional single stanza verbatim. The song only ever had one stanza, so verses 2 and 3 and the hook are NEWLY WRITTEN in exactly the same meter and rhyme scheme, keeping the 'Merrily, merrily' refrain line from the source.

song_style: children's nursery rhyme, cheerful upbeat kids song, cute female child voice, simple very repetitive catchy melody, gentle rocking tempo, playful, bright, warm
